judgments.reason: The model noted the commission is given after winning ('The winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin auction commission') but did not articulate that the commission is applied before payment or that bids above available coins are allowed as a result.

The model observed that the clerk can reveal committed rival bids, but did not articulate a mechanism whereby waiting reveals rival bids prior to your commitment; no claim that waiting lets you see rivals before committing was supported.

judgments.quote: Per the rules, all unresolved lots remain unsold at the eight-round horizon. I should close the auction now to settle the game with whatever outcomes have occurred.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly states that unresolved lots remain unsold at the eight-round horizon and recommends closing now to settle the game, which correctly identifies that close settles the game even with unauctioned lots.

The model described that winners receive a three-coin commission and that catalog buys exist, but did not claim or demonstrate that catalog purchases receive the auction commission; no mechanism linking buys to the commission was articulated.
